articles.title: RAM e volatile evidence: quando vale la pena acquisire prima di tutto il resto?
articles.description: Should investigators acquire RAM before anything else? This article weighs the value of volatile processes, active connections and encryption keys against memory smear, system instability and the forensic footprint of live acquisition.

articles.title: BitLocker, attenzione prima di spegnere il PC: potresti perdere l’accesso a tutti i tuoi dati
articles.description: A powered-on, BitLocker-protected computer may expose data while its volume is unlocked. The article explains why shutting down or removing storage can affect access, and how to assess recovery keys, acquisition alternatives and documentation before acting.

articles.title: A cosa serve la Digital Forensics? Quando una traccia digitale diventa una prova
articles.description: An account login, an IP address or a file export can be a useful digital trace without proving who acted. Using a concrete investigation scenario, this article distinguishes collection, preservation and analysis from attribution and defensible conclusions.

articles.title: La storia della Digital Forensics: dalle origini alle indagini digitali moderne
articles.description: From early computer investigations to smartphones, cloud services and AI, this article traces how forensic practice evolved around data integrity, reproducibility, tool verification, incomplete acquisitions and the limits of automated analysis.

articles.title: Live acquisition: perché preservare più evidenze potrebbe alterare il sistema
articles.description: Live acquisition trade-offs on powered-on systems, volatile digital evidence, unlocked encryption, memory smear, targeted collection and forensic documentation.

articles.title: Europol e Digital Forensics: il problema non è solo trovare le evidenze, ma sapere cosa manca
articles.description: An analysis of Europol's Digital Forensics: Gap Analysis, highlighting forensic tool validation, interoperability, evidence coverage and the need to understand discrepancies between tools.

articles.title: Computer acceso: le decisioni critiche che dobbiamo prendere per preservare le prove digitali
articles.description: Operational forensic choices involving powered-on computers, volatile evidence, active sessions, disk encryption, network isolation and evidence preservation.
